security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: A learning operating system for capturing, organizing, and reviewing notes
bundle.longDescription: NotesOS is a professional-grade learning operating system — a local-first desktop app for capturing, organizing, evolving, and reviewing learning notes, course materials, and analysis. It scales to 10,000+ notes, works fully offline, and provides instant retrieval through search, filters, tags, and backlinks.
